JSON Server wasn't restarted Sometimes changes aren't picked up correctly. Most likely: React Router param mismatch Show me your route definitions. If you have: } /> then: const { postId } = useParams(); will be: undefined because the parameter name is id, not postId. You would need: const { id } = useParams(); const safePostId = String(id); This is the most common cause. Quick test Put this near the top: console.log(useParams()); If you see: { id: "1" } then you've found the bug immediately.
